name: 婚礼宴会垂坠纱布桌旗款
description: 婚宴派对长桌布置，纱布垂坠质感配烛光花艺场景

styleLock.direction: romantic boho banquet table styling ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF and warm ivory wall #F7F3EC grounds, with real light oak flooring kept in frame on the scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight from the left at 5000-5200K, low contrast, gentle fabric fold shadows and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte solid walnut table #7B4F35, light oak floor #D8AC72, ivory linen or seamless white ground #F7F3EC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, text-free on the marketplace main image, one thin weight only for optional short callouts
styleLock.iconSystem: none, no icon graphics in this visual system
styleLock.presentationRules: the runner is always laid along the table axis with at least one end cascading over the edge and pooling on the floor, folds combed into even vertical ridges, place settings flanking symmetrically, nothing laid on top of the fabric, stable scale and slight 3/4 or straight-on angle across the set
noDrift: no glossy studio set replacing the walnut table and oak floor
no props covering the fabric surface
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent romantic boho banquet-styling visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory wall #F7F3EC, solid walnut table #7B4F35, brushed brass accent #C6A15B and charcoal text #3A3330, with the product tone always taken from the reference image; warm neutral overall; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for short optional callouts; no icon graphics; soft diffused daylight from the left around 5000-5200K, low contrast, gentle fabric shadows and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; matte walnut tabletop, light oak flooring and seamless ivory or white grounds; the runner is always laid along the table axis with at least one end cascading over the edge and pooling, combed into even vertical folds and never hidden under props; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净白底交代桌旗的垂坠褶皱形态
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, runner on a plain plinth, full length visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with a soft bounce fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond an even clean margin top and bottom
shots.promptTemplate: White-background e-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The runner laid along the axis of a plain ivory plinth and combed into even vertical folds, one short end cascading over the front edge; straight-on eye-level view with a slight 3/4 turn, full length visible and nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio light from the front-left with a soft bounce fill, and a soft contact shadow where the fabric tips touch the plinth. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, the fabric tone carried by {accent_color}. The {product} occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond an even clean margin at top and bottom. Negative: no flowers, no plates, no cutlery, no hands, no people, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off selvedge, no floating fabric without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心卖点，铺上就是一场婚礼宴会布置
shots.camera: symmetrical straight-on eye-level looking down the long axis of the table
shots.lighting: soft diffused daylight from the left around 5000K, low contrast, gentle fold shadows
shots.background: warm ivory studio wall #F7F3EC over a walnut tabletop #7B4F35
shots.props: one tall brass-tone candle stand with blank candles, two or three plain round plates flanking the axis
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper third for an optional headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} styled as a banquet table. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Symmetrical straight-on eye-level view looking down the long axis of the table, the runner running toward camera and pooling over the near edge; a tall candle stand with blank candles on the centre line and two or three plain round plates flanking it symmetrically. Soft diffused daylight from the left at about 5000K, low contrast, gentle fabric shadows. Background warm ivory studio wall #F7F3EC over a walnut table #7B4F35. The {product} occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space across the upper third for an optional headline. Negative: no readable text, no brand marks, no faces, no hands, no plastic-looking flowers, no clutter lying on the fabric, no mismatched shadow directions, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实家用餐桌场景，让买家想象自己铺开后的样子
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down along the table
shots.lighting: soft window light from the upper left at 5200K with warm bounce off the oak floor
shots.background: solid walnut dining table #7B4F35 with light oak floor #D8AC72 behind
shots.props: one place setting with a plain round plate and wood-handled cutlery, a few loose bloom stems along the fabric
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper right corner for optional copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} draped down the centre of a solid walnut dining table in a morning-light dining room. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the table, one place setting with a plain round plate and wood-handled cutlery at the near corner and a few loose bloom stems scattered down the right side of the fabric. Soft window light from the upper left at about 5200K, warm bounce off the oak floor, long soft folds and a subtle shadow where the fabric tips over the table edge. Surface walnut #7B4F35, background light oak floor #D8AC72 and an ivory wall. The {product} occupies 40-50% of the frame, generous negative space in the upper right corner for optional copy. Negative: no people, no visible faces or hands, no garbled text, no plastic-looking petals, no duplicated props, no floating fabric, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 展示长边垂地的瀑布效果与宴会厅纵深，撑起氛围价值
shots.camera: low angle almost at floor level, straight-on to the table end
shots.lighting: warm diffused light from the front-right around 5000K, gentle pooling shadow where the fabric meets the floor
shots.background: warm ivory wall #F7F3EC over a light oak floor #D8AC72
shots.props: walnut trestle table, candle stand and plates layered behind on the tabletop, one lantern and one potted plant soft-focused at the sides
shots.whitespace: generous clear space above the tabletop line for optional copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene from the head of a banquet table: {product} hung over the near end of a walnut trestle table so it cascades floor-length in one soft curtain of folds. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle almost at floor level, straight-on to the table end, with place settings and a candle stand layered behind on the tabletop and one lantern plus one potted plant softly out of focus at the sides. Warm diffused light from the front-right at about 5000K, with a gentle pooling shadow where the fabric meets the floor. Background warm ivory wall #F7F3EC over a light oak floor #D8AC72. The {product} occupies 40-50% of the frame, generous clear space above the tabletop line for optional copy. Negative: no hands, no faces, no readable signage, no duplicated table legs, no impossible reflections, no props in front of the cascade, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用稀疏纱织与褶皱肌理特写证明面料质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro shot almost from directly above, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the left opening up the weave, sweeping highlight along the fold crests, no harsh speculars
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the texture itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the gauze weave where the fabric gathers into soft ridges. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot almost from directly above with a shallow depth of field, foreground folds crisp and the far folds dissolving. Skimming side light from the left to open up the weave and a sweeping highlight along the crests, no harsh speculars. Pale ivory field background #FBF6F1 with the product tone {accent_color}. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace since the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no visible logo, no loose threads rendered as litter, no fabricated fibre labels, no extra text, no watermark, no plastic-looking textile.

shots.intent: 同款多色并列供买家按宴会配色选款，降低选择成本
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, matched crop across all three panels
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the front at 5500K, matched shadows on every panel
shots.props: three identical narrow tables, no other props
shots.whitespace: even margins between panels and no extra whitespace above the tables
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product}, the same runner laid in three colourways side by side on identical narrow tables. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level framing with an identical crop, fold count and drape on every panel so only the fabric tone changes; each swatch runs the width of its table and curls once over the front edge. Even soft studio light from the front at about 5500K with matched shadows across all three panels. Background soft greige field #F1E7DE, tones referenced through {accent_color}. The three variants together occupy 60-70% of the frame, even margins between panels and no extra whitespace above the tables. Negative: no mixed lighting between panels, no differing fold counts, no colour labels or rendered text, no faces, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no invented swatch names.

shots.intent: 收口消除风险，交代到手形态与平整易收纳，留白承接后续主张
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting with a soft front key, no dramatic shadow, faint contact shadows under the stack
shots.props: blank label tags and empty rule lines as unprinted placeholders
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for blank spec placeholders
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: {product} neatly folded into a stack beside a second rolled length of the same fabric on a clean surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with a soft front key and no dramatic shadow, faint contact shadows under the stack so nothing floats. Seamless white background #FFFFFF, product tone {accent_color}. The folded set occupies 35-40% of the frame overall, generous negative space on the right 40% kept for information slots. Keep every information slot empty: blank label tags, empty rule lines, unprinted seal outlines, unfilled indicator bars. Negative: no certificates, no ratings, no awards, no serial numbers, no readable text, no hands, no crumpled mess, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 高 45 度俯望胡桃木长桌，桌旗沿中轴铺开并垂过近边，一只素白圆盘与木柄餐具在左前，右侧散放小白花；002 近距俯拍烟粉纱布堆叠褶皱，见稀疏纱织与纸感压褶；003 正机位桌尾，桌旗如瀑布垂至地面，桌面有黄铜烛台与餐具，左地灯、右盆栽，象牙白墙与浅橡木地板；004 斜低位 X 形支架桌，桌旗垂地并在地板上堆褶；005 对称正机位沿桌轴，中央黄铜烛台、两侧四席素白盘；006 高位俯拍白布面长桌，桌旗成排竖褶铺向镜头，左上叠盘、右入黄铜烛脚。六张均为同一件纱布桌旗的不同机位与景别（五张餐桌布置场景加一张面料微距），非色卡式变体画廊，正常转化。品类判定依据：产品为无电无电机的餐桌布艺小件，Amazon 源路径为 Kitchen and Table Linens 下的 Table Runners，故定 L1 家居日用、L2 家纺布艺；不改判为家具家纺（该 L2 偏家具与床品大件）也不判家装灯具软装（偏灯饰建材）。结构说明：源套图无白底裸图与多色并列陈列，shot-01 白底首图与 shot-06 多色阵列为按转化漏斗补位的通用结构，面料色一律以 {accent_color} 占位；尺寸与规格数字不入稿，信任镜的信息位全部留空。已剥离内容：原销售品牌字标与店铺字样、图源平台角标与评价星条、原花艺与餐具的具体款式细节、原图文件名与元数据；产品主体一律以 {product} 占位，场景、机位、光线、台面与色板为可复用部分。
